```{r}
veldwerk_connect <- function(dbname) {
  # Read credentials from environment variables (.Renviron)
  host <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_HOST")
  port <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_PORT")
  user <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_USER")
  pass <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_PASS")
  
  # Check to ensure credentials are set
  if (host == "" || user == "" || pass == "") {
    stop("Database credentials are missing. Check your .Renviron file.")
  }
  
  DBI::dbConnect(
    drv      = RPostgres::Postgres(),
    dbname   = dbname,
    host     = host,
    port     = port,
    user     = user,
    password = pass
  )
}
```

```{r}
con_gw <- veldwerk_connect("mnmgwdb")
con_surf <- veldwerk_connect("mnmsurfdb")
con_le <- veldwerk_connect("loceval")
```

# Locevals

```{sql}
--| connection: con_le
--| output.var: le_fieldwork

WITH BASE AS (
  SELECT 
    SU.sampleunit_id
    , LOC.grts_address
    , SU.domain_part
    , V.date_start
    , V.date_visit
    , V.log_update as date_update
    , V.activity_group_id
    , unnest(string_to_array(SU.schemes, '|')) AS scheme
    , 1 as loceval
    , CASE
        WHEN V.issues THEN 0
        WHEN SU.type_is_absent THEN  0
        ELSE 1
      END AS loceval_approved
  FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
  INNER JOIN "inbound"."Visits" V
  ON LOC.location_id = V.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = V.grts_address
  INNER JOIN "outbound"."SampleUnits" SU
  ON V.sampleunit_id = SU.sampleunit_id
  INNER JOIN "metadata"."GroupedActivities" GA
  ON V.activity_group_id = GA.activity_group_id
  WHERE V.visit_done
  AND GA.activity_group LIKE 'LOCEVAL%'
)

SELECT * 
  FROM BASE
WHERE scheme IN ('GW_03.3', 'SOIL_03.2', 'SURF_03.4_lentic')
```

# Groundwater

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: gw_fieldwork_installations

SELECT 
  IV.sampleunit_id
  , IV.grts_address
  , SU.domain_part
  , IV.date_start
  , IV.date_visit
  , IV.watina_code_used_1_peilbuis
  , IV.watina_code_used_2_piezometer
  , 'GW_03.3' as scheme
FROM  "inbound"."InstallationVisits" IV
INNER JOIN "outbound"."SampleUnits" SU
ON IV.sampleunit_id = SU.sampleunit_id
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON IV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
WHERE NOT IV.issues
AND IV.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
```

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: gw_fieldwork_samples

SELECT 
  SV.sampleunit_id
  , SV.grts_address
  , SU.domain_part
  , SV.date_start
  , SV.date_visit
  , SV.log_update as date_update
  , 'GW_03.3' as scheme
FROM  "inbound"."SamplingVisits" SV
INNER JOIN "outbound"."SampleUnits" SU
ON SV.sampleunit_id = SU.sampleunit_id
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON SV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
WHERE NOT SV.issues
AND SV.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
```

# Surface water

```{sql}
--| connection: con_surf
--| output.var: surf_fieldwork

SELECT 
  VU.sampleunit_id
  , LOC.grts_address
  , SU.domain_part
  , VU.date_start
  , VU.date_visit
  , VU.log_update as date_update
  , 'SURF_03.4_lentic' as scheme
FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
INNER JOIN "inbound"."VisitsUnnested" VU
ON LOC.location_id = VU.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = VU.grts_address
INNER JOIN "inbound"."LenticVisits" LV
ON VU.visit_id = LV.visit_id
INNER JOIN "outbound"."SampleUnits" SU
ON VU.sampleunit_id = SU.sampleunit_id
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON VU.visit_id = FC.visit_id AND VU.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
WHERE NOT VU.issues
AND VU.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
ORDER BY grts_address
```

# Create snapshots

```{r}
snapshot_dir <- here::here(
  "100_reporting", "20261014_analysis_sv34", "data"
)
dir.create(snapshot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

snapshots <- list(
  le_fieldwork = le_fieldwork,
  gw_fieldwork_installations = gw_fieldwork_installations,
  gw_fieldwork_samples = gw_fieldwork_samples,
  surf_fieldwork = surf_fieldwork
)

for (name in names(snapshots)) {
  saveRDS(
    snapshots[[name]],
    file.path(snapshot_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")),
    version = 3
  )
}
```
